title: Ladybug wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body: red dome -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#e8202a'/>
  <!-- lighter red highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <!-- head lighter edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#3a3a52'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M40 22 Q34 12 26 12' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 22 Q66 12 74 12' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='12' r='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='12' r='3' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <!-- sunglasses: two lenses -->
  <rect x='33' y='28' width='15' height='11' rx='4' fill='#1a1a24'/>
  <rect x='52' y='28' width='15' height='11' rx='4' fill='#1a1a24'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x='36' y='30' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6ec6ff'/>
  <rect x='55' y='30' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6ec6ff'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='47' y='31' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#1a1a24'/>
  <!-- arms of glasses to head sides -->
  <rect x='29' y='30' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#1a1a24'/>
  <rect x='66' y='30' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#1a1a24'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 44 Q50 48 55 44' stroke='#3a3a52' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wing split line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='85' stroke='#8a1018' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='4.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='4.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M22 60 Q14 58 12 64' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 60 Q86 58 88 64' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 72 Q16 74 15 80' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 72 Q84 74 85 80' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
